query: with targets as (select l.id, se.name as series_name, l.title, coalesce(length(l.content), 0) as content_length, l.is_active from public.lessons l join public.chapters ch on ch.id=l.chapter_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=ch.subject_id join public.series se on se.id=ch.series_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=ch.level_id where lv.name='Terminale' and sub.name='SVT' and se.name in ('A1','A2') and l.title='La biosynthèse des protéines') select series_name,title,content_length,is_active,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=targets.id) as exercise_count,(select bool_and(e.is_active=false and e.is_published=false) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=targets.id) as exercises_all_drafts,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=targets.id) as quiz_count,(select bool_and(q.is_active=false and q.is_published=false) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=targets.id) as quizzes_all_drafts from targets order by series_name; with selected as (select c.id,s.name as subject_name,c.is_active,c.is_validated,ct.theme,(select count(*) from public.citation_scopes cs where cs.citation_id=c.id) as scope_count from public.citations c join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where (c.created_at='2026-08-20 21:03:54.235981+00'::timestamptz and s.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie')) or c.quote_text in ('Je le répète avec une certitude plus véhémente : la vérité est en marche, et rien ne l’arrêtera.','Tous pour un, un pour tous.','Enfin chacun se donnant à tous ne se donne à personne.')), per_theme as (select subject_name,theme,count(*) as theme_count from selected group by subject_name,theme), summary as (select subject_name,count(*) as citation_count,bool_and(is_active=false and is_validated=false) as all_drafts,min(scope_count) as minimum_scope_count,max(scope_count) as maximum_scope_count from selected group by subject_name) select summary.subject_name,summary.citation_count,summary.all_drafts,summary.minimum_scope_count,summary.maximum_scope_count,count(per_theme.theme) as distinct_theme_count,min(per_theme.theme_count) as citations_per_theme_min,max(per_theme.theme_count) as citations_per_theme_max from summary join per_theme on per_theme.subject_name=summary.subject_name group by summary.subject_name,summary.citation_count,summary.all_drafts,summary.minimum_scope_count,summary.maximum_scope_count order by summary.subject_name;
